battle.name: 唐朝開國戰爭
battle.brief: 隋大業九年起，關中、中原與河東同時開戰，李淵以太原軍進據長安，李密、竇建德、王世充、劉武周各霸一方。卡面這件羅馬標槍在中國戰場並無角色，只說明破盾投擲兵器的作用；虎牢關、洛陽與介休決定勝負的，是長矛方盾、蹶張弩、十字弩、拋石撞車，以及玄甲騎的衝鋒與洛口倉的糧秣。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方並非兩個國家，而是隋朝與隋末並起的數支武裝集團。隋朝以長安為西都、洛陽為東都，煬帝即位後巡遊江都，中央仍以尚書省、門下省、內史省三省分掌政務，軍權歸於大將軍與行軍元帥；府兵是軍隊骨幹，另有宿衛禁軍與臨時抽調的鄉兵，到開戰前兵制已由常備轉為臨時募集，十二軍分統天下兵馬，糧秣需就地徵發，遠征與防守都受糧道牽制。關中方面，以李淵為首的唐軍自太原起兵，聚合關隴世族、府兵舊部與歸附的隋軍，設大將軍張士貴、將軍獨孤彥信等幕職，李世民自領行軍總管，尉遲敬德、段志玄、秦叔寶、程知節、房玄齡、杜如晦、長孫無忌與李勣先後入幕。河北方面，竇建德建國號夏，設官屬與軍府，與劉武周相約南北合擊，麾下有凌敬、范德方、田雄等，兵力橫跨河北諸郡。洛陽方面，王世充以驅逐越王楊侑、掌控宿衛起家，西面受李密壓迫，北面接應劉武周，東面又與竇建德交兵，一度四面受敵。山東的瓦崗軍由翟讓創建、李密主事，據洛口倉屯糧，部眾以山東、河南的降卒與流民為主，核心將領有房彥藻、王伯當、祖君道等，裴仁基、羅士信先後來歸，尉遲敬德、秦叔寶、程知節最終亦由瓦崗軍轉入唐軍。劉武周在馬邑起兵後自稱定楊可汗，受東突厥冊封，眾至十餘萬，與竇建德相約取並州、下洛陽，從地緣與兵力看，是唐在北面最致命的一支。劉黑闥與輔公祏先後在河北與淮南復起，使唐的統一過程一再拉長。
countriesEn: The opposing sides of this war were not two states but the Sui dynasty and a number of armed groups that rose as the Sui came apart. The Sui held its western capital at Chang'an and its eastern capital at Luoyang; with the Yangdi emperor away at Jiangdu, government still ran through the three departments of the secretariat, the chancellery and the imperial secretariat, while military command belonged to the great generals and to the commanders of each campaign. The fubing were the backbone of the armies, supplemented by the palace guard and by locally recruited militia, and by the time the fighting began the system had already shifted from a standing army to ad hoc levies, with the realm divided into twelve armies under separate commanders and grain levied wherever the troops went. On the Guanzhong side, the Tang forces of Li Yuan rose at Taiyuan, gathering the aristocratic clans of Guanzhong and Longxi, old fubing cadres and surrendered Sui soldiers; they set up a staff with Zhang Shigui as great general and Dugu Yanxin as commander, while Li Shimin took charge of the expeditionary host, with Yuchi Jingde, Duan Zhixuan, Qin Qiong, Cheng Zhijie, Fang Xuanling, Du Ruhui, Changsun Wuji and Li Ji among those who served under him. In Hebei, Dou Jiande proclaimed the state of Xia with its own offices and commands, agreed with Liu Wuzhou to strike north and south in concert, and counted Ling Jing, Fan Defang and Tian Xiong among his commanders, his strength spanning the commanderies of Hebei. At Luoyang, Wang Shichong had risen by driving out the Prince of Yue and seizing the palace guard; pressed from the west by Li Mi, joined from the north to Liu Wuzhou, and at war with the Xia in the east, he was beset on every side. The Wagang army in the east had been founded by Zai Rang and led in practice by Li Mi; it based itself on the granary of Luokou and drew its numbers from surrendered soldiers and displaced men of Shandong and Henan, with Fang Yanhao, Wang Bodang and Zujundao among its leaders, Pei Renji and Luo Shixin joining later, and Yuchi Jingde, Qin Qiong and Cheng Zhijie eventually passing from the Wagang army into Tang service. Liu Wuzhou rose at Mayi, styled himself Prince of Dingyang, was invested by the Eastern Turks and drew a following of more than a hundred thousand; his agreement with Dou Jiande to take Bingzhou and descend on Luoyang made him the most dangerous enemy to the Tang in the north, in both numbers and position. Liu Heidao and Fu Gongshi rose again in Hebei and in the south of the Yangtze, prolonging the process of unification.
people: 李淵是西魏以來關隴軍事集團的核心，任隋太原留守，早看出隋室的崩解徵兆，經劉文靜、裴寂勸說，於隋大業十一年冬在太原起兵，誓師之日三軍推其為主，入關中後每逢大軍會集必與諸將共誓，遂於次年五月在長安即位建立唐朝，年號武德。他長於守成而臨陣果決不足，故歷次大戰多交託李世民。李世民是全場最關鍵的指揮者：從太原起兵時以行軍總管身分統軍，攻克長安之夜即親當鋒，後又於虎牢關破竇建德、圍洛陽迫王世充出降、平定劉黑闥、滅東突厥，貞觀年間被立為太子。河北的竇建德與洛陽的王世充是唐之外最強的兩股武裝，竇以農夫軍紀律嚴整作戰頑強，王世充則長於守城與機變，兩人互為強敵：李密在虎牢關外為王世充所敗而失去洛陽，竇建德則在虎牢關被李世民誘出，於牛口渚遭騎兵衝擊而全軍崩潰，負傷被俘送往洛陽。李密是瓦崗軍真正的統帥，善治軍屯糧，屢破隋將張須陀，卻因部眾紀律鬆散、糧道過度依賴洛口倉而失敗。劉武周為山西強豪，趁李世民遠征未歸一度攻陷太原與並州，終被唐軍在介休、雀鼠谷一帶追擊敗亡，部將康蘇勛以汾州降唐。劉黑闥、輔公祏先後再起，兩年之內即被平定。東突厥頗利可汗既是劉武周的靠山，也在渭水之盟時成為唐軍的援軍，說明草原勢力在唐初扮演雙重角色。
peopleEn: Li Yuan was the core of the Guanzhong military group that had descended from Western Wei, and as Sui commander at Taiyuan he read the signs of the dynasty's collapse early; after being urged by Liu Wenjing and Pei Ji, he raised troops at Taiyuan in the winter of the eleventh year of the Daye era, the three armies acclaiming him as leader on the day of the oath, and after entering Guanzhong he shared the oath with his generals at every mustering of the army, until in the fifth month of the following year he was enthroned at Chang'an and founded the Tang, with the first era name Wude. He was strong in administration and less decisive in the field, so he entrusted the great battles to Li Shimin. Li Shimin was the decisive commander of the whole war: he led the expeditionary host from the rising at Taiyuan, was personally in the front rank on the night Chang'an fell, and afterwards broke Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, besieged Luoyang until Wang Shichong came out and surrendered, destroyed Liu Heidao and annihilated the Eastern Turks, and was made crown prince in the Zhenguan years. Dou Jiande of Hebei and Wang Shichong of Luoyang were the two strongest armed groups outside the Tang: Dou fought stubbornly with the strict discipline of a peasant army, while Wang excelled in siege defence and manoeuvring, and the two were each other's rival. Li Mi was defeated by Wang Shichong outside Hulao Pass and lost Luoyang, while Dou Jiande was lured out by Li Shimin at Hulao Pass, his army broken by a cavalry charge at Niukou Ford, and he was taken wounded and sent to Luoyang. Li Mi was the real commander of the Wagang army, skilled in keeping order and storing grain, and repeatedly defeated the Sui general Zhang Xutuo, yet he failed because his men were slack and his supply line depended too heavily on the granary at Luokou. Liu Wuzhou, a powerful landowner of Shanxi, seized Taiyuan and Bingzhou while Li Shimin was away on campaign, and was finally run down and destroyed at Jiexiu and in the Queshu Valley, one of his generals, Kang Suxun, surrendering Fenzhou to the Tang. Liu Heidao and Fu Gongshi rose in turn and were put down within two years. The Eastern Turkic ruler, the khagan Bieli, was both Liu Wuzhou's patron and, at the treaty on the Wei River, the Tang army's ally, which shows the double role played by the steppe powers at the beginning of the Tang.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍是羅馬共和國軍團步兵的標準投擲兵器，約半米長、槍桿中空，槍幹後段做成可彎折的柔性段，命中盾面後彎斷留在盾上，使盾牌難以回收再用。它在這場中國戰役中並無任何角色，羅馬兵制與隋唐相隔七百餘年，兩者唯一的關係在戰術功能上：都是以輕型投擲兵器在接觸前削弱敵軍的盾面。隋唐戰場上承擔同一位置的是弓弩與標槍。隋軍與唐軍的步兵以兩米以上的長矛配大盾列陣，盾有牛皮胎與木胎漆飾數種，矛兵居中，弓弩手居前展開；弩以蹶張弩與十字弩為主，一發可重創密集隊形，隋書記載的甲弩即重裝弩機關，專供守城與攻堅之需。重裝衝撞與遠程破壞由砲擔當，拋石機、撞車、雲梯、巢車配合援索與穴地攻城，攻城時另有火矢與早期火藥的附著燃燒試用。騎兵是唐軍取勝的關鍵，關內產馬，兵馬披具裝並著甲，甲胄以明光為名，李世民自太原起兵後組建玄甲騎，全軍著黑衣，成為中軍的精銳突擊力量。東突厥騎兵同樣精於奔射，渭水之盟時李淵以財帛與突厥結為兄弟，得以借得精騎。糧秣方面，洛口倉是瓦崗軍與唐軍共同倚賴的樞紐，關中的運轉則靠漕運與驛傳維持。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card was the standard throwing weapon of the infantry of the Roman republican legions: about half a metre long, with a hollow shaft whose rear section was made deliberately flexible, so that after striking a shield it bent and broke off there and left the shield hard to recover and reuse. It played no part whatever in this Chinese campaign; the Roman military system and the Sui-Tang one are more than seven centuries apart, and the only relationship between them is functional: both used a light missile to break up the enemy's shields before contact. In the Sui and Tang battlefield the same role was filled by bows, crossbows and javelins. The infantry of both Sui and Tang formed up with piers more than two metres long and large shields, of leather-faced and lacquered wood in several patterns, with spearmen in the centre and archers and crossbowmen deployed in front. The crossbows were chiefly the strong-arm crossbow and the repeating crossbow, a single bolt capable of gutting a crowded formation, and the armoured crossbow recorded in the History of Sui served the needs of siege and of defending a breach. Heavy ramming and long-range destruction were the work of artillery: stone-throwers, battering rams, scaling ladders and siege towers, worked in combination with rope bridges and with mines dug under the walls; attacking parties also used fire-arrows and early attempts at setting incendiaries alight. Cavalry was the key to the Tang victory: the interior of Guanzhong bred horses, the horses were caparisoned and the troopers armoured, with the brightest plate named after the ming Guang, and after the rising at Taiyuan Li Shimin formed the Black Armoured Guard, dressed entirely in black, which became the elite striking force of the central army. The Eastern Turkic horsemen were equally expert at riding and shooting at gallop, and at the treaty on the Wei River Li Yuan made the Turks his brothers and received cavalry from them. As for supply, the granary at Luokou was the hinge on which both the Wagang army and the Tang depended, while the Guanzhong base was kept going by river transport and by the courier and remount system.
tactics: 起兵本身就是一次計畫周密的奇襲：李淵以主力自太原南下，諸將分道假道，隋將尚在推斷主公去向時，唐軍已抵長安城下。攻克長安的夜戰，舊唐書記尉遲敬德率敢死之士乘小旗登城、內應開門，隋軍瓦解，長安遂定。定下關中之後，唐軍避免與擅長野戰的河北軍正面硬拼，改採兩步走：先以關中為基地待機，讓河北與洛陽兩軍互相消耗。虎牢關之戰是全場最漂亮的野戰範例：李世民把戰場選在板渚與汜水之間的牛口渚，遣裴行儼挑戰竇建德，再以程知節、李世勣分道包抄，親率精騎自側翼衝擊敵陣中斷，竇軍主力一被截斷即整體崩潰，追擊三十餘里，王世充的援軍在虎牢關外望風而潰。洛陽之戰改為長期圍城：唐軍合圍洛陽、斷其糧道、修築塹壕，並以弩砲攻城，鄭軍屢次突圍求援皆告失敗，一年後城中糧盡，王世充眾叛親離，只好率官屬出降。平定劉武周的過程以急行軍與追擊為主：秦王軍自太原南下，連下太原、並州，追至雀鼠谷，全軍疲憊而敵眾潰散，遂大量受降。兵糧與補給線是每場戰役真正的勝負手，唐軍在關中徵粟、在洛陽爭洛口倉，瓦崗軍正因糧道過於集中在洛口倉而崩潰。
tacticsEn: The rising itself was a carefully planned surprise: Li Yuan brought his main body south from Taiyuan while his generals took separate by-paths, and while the Sui commanders were still working out which way his ruler had gone, the Tang army was already beneath the walls of Chang'an. The night assault that took the city is recorded in the Old Book of Tang, where Yuchi Jingde led a band of volunteers up the wall behind a small banner and opened the gate from within, the Sui army disintegrating and Chang'an falling. Once secure in Guanzhong, the Tang stopped trying to break the Hebei army in a frontal clash, for the Hebei men were the best at manoeuvre in the open, and adopted a two-stage method instead: hold in the Guanzhong base and wait for the Hebei and Luoyang armies to wear each other down. The battle at Hulao Pass is the finest field engagement of the whole war: Li Shimin chose the ground at Niukou Ford between Ban Zhu and the Si River, sent Pei Xingjian to challenge Dou Jiande, brought Cheng Zhijie and Li Ji round on two separate lines, and led his cavalry in against the flank so that the centre of the Xia army was cut; once the main body was broken the whole formation collapsed, the pursuit ran over thirty li, and the relieving force of Wang Shichong melted away before Hulao Pass. The siege of Luoyang was fought as a blockade: the Tang closed the city in, cut its supply, built trenches and drove the walls with bolts and stones, and the Zheng army failed again and again when it broke out to seek help; a year later, with the grain exhausted and the garrison deserting him, Wang Shichong had to come out and surrender with his officials. The war against Liu Wuzhou was fought with forced marches and pursuit: the prince's army came south from Taiyuan, retook Taiyuan and Bingzhou and ran Liu Wuzhou down to the Queshu Valley, where the Tang was exhausted and the enemy dissolved, so that a great many surrendered. Supply was the real arbiter of every engagement: the Tang drew grain in Guanzhong and fought for the granary at Luokou outside Luoyang, and it was precisely the Wagang army's concentration of its supply line at Luokou that brought it down.
data: 時間跨度是這場戰爭最直觀的一組數字：始於隋大業九年，即公元六一三年；國內主要戰線到六二三年輔公祏平定告一段落；北方邊患至六三〇年陰山之戰後才告收束，前後近二十年。兵力的零散記載可以互相對照：六一三年河南各州郡縣相繼反叛，隋書與通鑑所記多則數萬之眾；同年八月楊玄感在黎陽起兵，旬日之間聚眾數萬，兩月而敗。瓦崗軍在六一八年破隋軍於洛口倉，舊唐書所記旬日之間收降卒二十餘萬，糧食數十萬石，李密部眾由數萬膨脹至數十萬。虎牢關之戰，竇建德出動的軍隊被記為五萬餘人，戰後斬首三千餘級、俘虜五萬餘人，王世充的援軍號稱十餘萬而至。對劉武周的介休追擊，唐軍記獲降卒數萬、馬匹數千匹。滅東突厥時，舊唐書記繳獲帳幕、牛羊以百萬計，李靖夜襲定襄之後，頗利可汗敗走至鐵山被擒。兵費方面，隋朝三次征討高句麗之後，府兵番上之制已難以維持，租調與役使的實際徵發額遠超制度所定的比例，各州郡因此無法按期供應。
dataEn: The span of the war is the most direct set of figures available: it began in the ninth year of the Daye era, that is 613; the main theatres inside the empire were settled by the defeat of Fu Gongshi in 623; the northern frontier was not closed until after the battle at Yinshan in 630. Altogether it ran through almost twenty years. The scattered troop figures can be checked against one another. In 613 the commanderies and counties of Henan rose in succession, the histories of Sui and Zizhi Tongjian recording crowds of several tens of thousands in many places; in the eighth month of the same year Yang Xuangan rose at Liyang, gathering tens of thousands of men within ten days and being defeated within two months. In 618 the Wagang army broke the Sui at the Luokou granary; the Old Book of Tang records that within ten days they took more than two hundred thousand surrendered soldiers and a hundred thousand odd measures of grain, so that Li Mi's force swelled from a few thousand to several hundred thousand. At Hulao Pass Dou Jiande is recorded as having brought out more than fifty thousand men; afterwards three thousand odd were killed and more than fifty thousand taken prisoner, while Wang Shichong's relieving force is said to have numbered a hundred thousand and more. In the pursuit of Liu Wuzhou at Jiexiu the Tang are recorded as taking several tens of thousands of surrendered men and several thousand horses. In the destruction of the Eastern Turks the Old Book of Tang records captured tents and cattle and sheep by the hundred thousand; after Li Jing's night attack on Dingxiang, Bieli was driven back to the Iron Mountains and captured. As for the cost: after three campaigns against Goguryeo the fubing rotation could no longer be sustained, and the real levies of tax, tribute and labour far exceeded the proportions the system prescribed, so that the prefectures and counties could no longer deliver their quotas on time.
cause: 導火線是隋煬帝的執政方式。開皇年間留下的制度在煬帝手上被推到極限：兩度大舉巡遊江都，營建東都與永濟渠，三次征討高句麗，每一次都把天下的人力物力往北調、往南運，府兵番上與租調徵發同時被拉緊，制度上的應急徵召變成常態。無休止的戰事與工程使各州郡無法按期供應，郡縣的武裝與豪族趁機自保，征遼的隊伍在回程時大批逃散，地方上的義軍隨之成型。六一二至六一三年間，從齊郡鄒平到河北、河南、江南，號稱反隋的武裝陸續出現：王薄在鄒平唱出無向遼東浪死歌，劉武周殺縣令據馬邑，竇建德在河北聚眾，瓦崗寨的翟讓起兵而李密歸之；洛陽的楊玄感以宗室身分在黎陽舉兵，天下豪族多所響應，卻因孤軍深入而敗。權力中樞也迅速空洞化：宇文化及弒隋煬帝於江都，李密、王世充各自挾持皇泰主楊侑與越王侑，帝號成為各軍爭奪的名分資源。就在這個時候，關中出現了唯一一支具備地理、軍事與制度三方面資源的軍隊，即太原留守李淵的部眾，這就是唐朝開國戰爭的真正起點。
causeEn: The trigger was the way the Yangdi emperor governed. The institutions left by the Kaihuang years were pushed to their limit under him: two great progresses to Jiangdu, the building of the eastern capital and of the Yongji canal, and three campaigns against Goguryeo, each time moving the labour and wealth of the empire northward and southward, while the rotation of the fubing and the collection of rent and tribute were tightened at the same time, so that what had been a temporary emergency levy became the standing rule. Endless campaigns and construction left the prefectures unable to deliver their quotas; the armed bands of the commanderies and the great clans armed themselves for their own protection, the columns returning from Liaodong broke up and dispersed on the march home, and local rebel forces took shape. Between 612 and 613 armed groups calling themselves anti-Sui appeared one after another from Zouping in Qizhou to Hebei, Henan and the south of the Yangtze: Wang Bo sang his song of no road to the east and a death in Liaodong, Liu Wuzhou killed the magistrate of Mayi and seized it, Dou Jiande gathered a following in Hebei, Zai Rang rose at Wagang and Li Mi joined him, and in Luoyang the imperial clansman Yang Xuangan took up arms at Liyang and was answered by great families across the realm, only to fall because he pressed forward with a single army. The centre of power emptied out just as fast: Yuwen Huaji murdered the Sui emperor at Jiangdu, Li Mi and Wang Shichong each held the Prince of Yue or the Prince of Tai in their hands, and the imperial title became a resource to be fought over. At that moment there appeared in Guanzhong the one force that possessed resources in geography, in arms and in institutions, the troops of Li Yuan, commander at Taiyuan. That is the true starting point of the war that founded the Tang.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果是重新整理了整個東亞的政治版圖。國內方面，隋末並存的大小武裝被逐一併入唐的編制，關隴軍事集團成為新的統治核心，府兵制在貞觀年間與均田制、租庸調制互相咬合，形成延續近三百年、可支撐大規模兵團作戰的國家軍事結構，貞觀後期又出現府兵與募兵互補的調整。制度層面上，隋文帝與煬帝留下的三省制、選科取士的雛形與州縣行政被唐承接並修訂，唐初對河北的安撫與對山東流民的重新編戶，直接決定了貞觀之治能否落實。邊疆方面，頗利可汗的內附與鐵勒諸部的歸附，使唐在漠北取得空前的地緣優勢，六二九年李靖夜襲定襄、六三〇年陰山之戰的勝利，讓唐第一次把防禦線推到陰山以北，也重組了東突厥與室韋之間的權力格局。對外關係上，統一的中原王朝重新打開西域通道，之後的安西都護府與西域都護府建立在這場戰爭奠定的局面之上。長期影響同樣存在：戰爭中河北豪族與北方軍鎮勢力的抬頭，成了安史之亂與藩鎮割據的伏線；冷兵器會戰的規模、攻城技術與後勤組織在這十幾年裡被推到唐以前未曾有過的高度，後世以隋唐為基準的戰役編制都由此而立。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was a redrawing of the political map of East Asia. Inside the empire, the rival armed groups of the late Sui were absorbed one by one into the Tang order, the military group of Guanzhong and Longxi became the new ruling core, and the fubing system, in the Zhenguan years, locked into the equal-field system and the rent-yong-diao levies to form a state military structure that lasted nearly three hundred years and could support operations on a large scale, with a later adjustment in the Zhenguan years in which fubing and recruited troops complemented one another. At the institutional level, the three departments, the embryo of the examination system and the prefectural administration left by the Sui emperors were taken over and revised by the Tang, and the pacification of Hebei and the re-registration of the displaced men of Shandong in the early Tang decided directly whether the Zhenguan government could actually be put into practice. On the frontier, the submission of the khagan Bieli and of the various Tiele tribes gave the Tang an unprecedented strategic advantage in the northern steppe; the night attack on Dingxiang by Li Jing in 629 and the victory at Yinshan in 630 pushed the Tang defensive line north of the Yinshan range for the first time and rearranged the balance of power between the Eastern Turks and the Xueyantuo. In foreign relations, a unified central plain state reopened the routes to the western regions, and the Protectorates of Anxi and of the Western Regions rested on the situation this war established. The long-term consequences are equally real: the rise of the great Hebei families and of the northern military governors during the fighting planted the seed of the An Lushan rebellion and of the fanzhen; and the scale of the pitched battles, the siegecraft and the logistic organisation were pushed within these fifteen years to heights never reached before the Tang, so that the order of battle of later armies, which took the Sui and Tang as their model, was founded here.
result: 六一八年五月，李淵在長安即位，改元武德，唐朝開國；此後十餘年是一場接一場的收編戰爭。六一九年劉武周攻陷太原，世民自洛州回師南下，六二〇年在介休、雀鼠谷一帶擊破之，收並州與汾州，斬首與受降都在萬級以上，山西重新歸入唐的版圖。六二一年五月虎牢關破夏，竇建德被俘，河北最大的一股武裝瓦解；同年唐軍合圍洛陽，王世充出降，唐得洛陽與隋朝兩京，瓦崗軍殘部如程知節、秦叔寶等隨之歸唐，隋末最大的兩座兵源與糧食中心都換了主人。六二二年劉黑闥再起河北，六二三年輔公祏以淮南反，唐軍分別由李世勣、李孝恭平之，國內大局底定。六二六年玄武門之變後太宗即位，改元貞觀；六三〇年李靖大破頗利可汗於陰山，刻石燕然，北境問題暫時解決，開國與統一的戰爭至此收尾。回頭看，決定勝負的並非任何一件單兵器的性能，而是關中的地勢與糧源、關隴世族的人脈、對北方騎兵外交的運用、攻城器械的進步，以及對敵方疲勞與內部矛盾的耐心等待。
resultEn: In the fifth month of 618 Li Yuan was enthroned at Chang'an, changed the era to Wude, and the Tang was founded; the following decade and more was a series of wars of absorption. In 619 Liu Wuzhou seized Taiyuan; Li Shimin came south from Luozhou and in 620 broke him around Jiexiu and the Queshu Valley, recovering Bingzhou and Fenzhou, with the killed and the surrendered both counted in the tens of thousands, and Shanxi returned to the Tang map. In the fifth month of 621 Hulao Pass broke the Xia, Dou Jiande was taken prisoner and the largest armed force in Hebei came apart; in the same year the Tang closed round Luoyang, Wang Shichong came out and surrendered, the Tang gained Luoyang and the two Sui capitals, and the remnants of the Wagang army, men such as Cheng Zhijie and Qin Qiong, followed him into Tang service, so that the two greatest sources of soldiers and grain of the late Sui changed hands. Liu Heidao rose again in Hebei in 622 and Fu Gongshi rebelled in the south of the Yangtze in 623; the Tang armies of Li Ji and Li Xiaogong put them down respectively, and the situation inside the empire was settled. After the affair at Xuanwu Gate in 626 the crown prince took the throne and changed the era to Zhenguan; in 630 Li Jing routed Bieli at Yinshan and had the victory carved on stone at Yanran, the northern question was provisionally resolved, and the war of foundation and unification came to its close. Looking back, what decided the outcome was not the performance of any single weapon, but the terrain and the grain of Guanzhong, the connections of the Guanzhong-Longxi clans, the use made of steppe cavalry diplomacy, the improvement of siege engines, and above all a patient waiting for the enemy to tire and for contradictions to open inside him.
